headline: Vanguard open conference play with a win over Westmont
dek: Vanguard beat Westmont in the conference's opening match on Wednesday, their second win of the season against one draw and five defeats. They have scored eleven goals and conceded twenty-two, more than any other programme in the conference. Westmont came in on a run of draws and leave with nothing.
displaced_by: Conference play opened; Vanguard beat Westmont in the first conference match of the season

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's seventeen goals are more than Jessup, Hawai'i Hilo and Biola have scored together, yet they have conceded fifteen.

wire.line: Concordia Irvine won at Biola and now have more wins than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Westmont's defeat at Vanguard on Wednesday was their fifth against two wins and three draws; they have scored sixteen goals and conceded nineteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought two wins, one draw and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have been beaten in all six matches they have played, scoring three goals and conceding fifteen; their next match is at Point Loma on Thursday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Hilo have lost three matches in a row after opening with three wins; the defeat at MSU Denver leaves them with five goals scored and five conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Point Loma drew with Westmont on Saturday and have three wins, three draws and two defeats, with fifteen goals scored and eleven conceded.

last_match.line: Vanguard have yet to win away from home; Westmont's only away win came at Simon Fraser in August.

next_match.line: Point Loma are unbeaten at home this season; Chaminade have yet to take a point anywhere.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
